name: rr_lookup
description: Search the ingested R&R PDF documents using vector search. Use whenever a CDM asks about roles, responsibilities, who owns a task, or whether something is chargeable.

description.description: Natural-language description of the service or task to match

codes.description: Optional list of candidate codes to narrow the search

name: price_lookup
description: Search the ingested AS Pricing List using vector search. Use whenever a CDM asks about price, cost, or EUR value of a service.

service_code.description: The R&R service code to look up (e.g. INFRA_1.8.10)

name: create_request
description: Create a new AS request entry in the database. Always show the CDM a summary of what will be created and ask for confirmation before calling this.

requestTitle.description: Short title for the request, e.g. 'HANA DB Upgrade — PRD'

additionalServiceIds.description: Comma-separated R&R service codes e.g. MOVE_1.3.04

description.description: Free-text description of the requested service

poNumber.description: PO number if provided in the email

assignedCDM.description: CDM email address — use the logged-in CDM

name: generate_o2i_ticket
description: Generate the JIRA O2I invoice ticket body for an AS request. Returns the draft ticket for CDM review before submission.

request_id.description: The AS request ID to generate the O2I ticket for

name: confirm_o2i_invoiced
description: Confirm that the O2I JIRA ticket has been submitted and mark the AS request as Invoiced.

request_id.description: The AS request ID to mark as Invoiced

name: render_record_panel
description: Render a record-card or status-timeline panel for a specific AS request.

name: render_data_panel
description: Render a data-display panel: record-table, kpi-strip, checklist, or rr-source.

type.description: Panel type: record-table, kpi-strip, checklist, or rr-source

data.description: Panel data — object or array depending on type

name: render_action_panel
description: Render an action panel: email-draft, field-form, confirm-dialog, or ticket-ref.

type.description: Panel type: email-draft, field-form, confirm-dialog, ticket-ref

name: render_notice_panel
description: Render a reminder-banner notice panel.

name: fetch_records
description: Query AS requests from the database. Returns matching records.

name: surface_pending_action
description: Create a PendingAction and push a card to the CDM Inbox.

userId.description: User ID to surface the action for

automationId.description: Automation ID that triggered this action

prompt.description: Prompt text shown to the CDM in the inbox card

name: resolve_pending_action
description: Mark a PendingAction as responded or dismissed.

pendingActionId.description: The pending action ID to resolve

name: process_meeting_notes
description: Extract structured data from raw ops meeting notes and store it on the client's dashboard. Call this when the user pastes or uploads meeting notes text.

raw_text.description: The full raw meeting notes text pasted or uploaded by the CDM

name: patch_meeting_note
description: Apply one or more targeted updates to the stored meeting notes for the active client. Returns a diff — show to CDM and ask for confirmation before calling confirm_meeting_note_patch.

patches.description: List of patch operations to apply

name: confirm_meeting_note_patch
description: Write the pending meeting note patches to the database. Only call this AFTER patch_meeting_note has returned a diff AND the CDM has explicitly confirmed the changes.

name: parse_email
description: Parse a raw customer email to extract AS request fields: customer name, service identifiers, ticket numbers, PO number, urgency notes.

raw_email.description: The full text of the customer email to parse

name: draft_price_email
description: Draft a price-communication email for an AS request.

customer_name.description: Customer display name for the salutation

service_codes.description: List of service codes covered by the email

prices.description: Map of service_code to price string

name: update_record
description: Update fields on an AS request. Always show the CDM what will change before calling this.

fields.description: Field name to new value map

name: link_session_to_customer
description: Link the current general conversation session to a specific customer.

customer_agent_id.description: The CustomerAgent.ID (UUID) to link this session to

name: route_to_agent
description: Delegate to a Customer Orchestrator or Contract Subagent. Response comes back in same thread.

handoffSummary.description: Summary of context for the receiving agent

message.description: The message to deliver to the delegated agent

request_ids.description: List of request IDs relevant to this handoff

name: get_reminder_status
description: Check which reminder rules are currently firing for the CDM's open requests.

cdmOwner.description: CDM email to check reminders for (defaults to logged-in CDM)
